goal-relic: Today, {fullName}, {epithet}, travels the roads in search of a lost relic said to mend what was broken.
goal-revenge: Today, {firstName} follows the trail of an old enemy, sworn that the hunt will end only with one of them in the grave.
goal-home: All {firstName} wants now is to find the way home, wherever home turns out to be.
goal-crown: {fullName}, {epithet}, has set {{his|her|their}} eyes on a crown, and the road to it runs through every tavern, court and battlefield of the realm.
goal-map: In {{his|her|their}} pack lies a torn map pointing to a city swallowed by the sands, and {firstName} intends to find it before anyone else.
goal-letter: An oath made to a dying friend binds {firstName} to deliver a sealed letter to a queen who may not want to read it.
goal-company: {firstName} is gathering a company of adventurers, convinced that the coming storm cannot be faced alone.
goal-dragon: Rumours of a dragon waking in the north have reached {firstName}, who is already sharpening blades and plans.
goal-redemption: Haunted by an old mistake, {firstName} wanders from town to town, hoping each good deed weighs a little against the past.
goal-legend: {fullName} wants only one thing: that bards will still sing of {{his|her|their}} deeds long after the last candle has gone out.
goal-sibling: Today, {firstName} searches every town and tavern for a sibling who vanished years ago, following the faintest rumour.
goal-book: {fullName}, {epithet}, is hunting for the last copy of a forbidden book, before those who want it burned find it first.
goal-school: {firstName} dreams of founding a school where anyone, rich or poor, could learn the skills that saved {{his|her|their}} life.
goal-cure: A curse is slowly turning the people of {firstName}'s village to stone, and the only cure is said to lie beyond the edge of every map.
goal-debt: {firstName} owes a dangerous amount of gold to a patient and very well-informed creditor, and every adventure is a payment.
goal-heir: {fullName}, {epithet}, has sworn to protect a young heir hidden among commoners until the day the stolen throne can be reclaimed.
